jyutping: jan4 zi1 co1, hau2 do1 do1
english_meaning: At the start of life, the mouth runs nonstop — children speak without restraint.

jyutping: siu3 ke4 ke4, fong3 duk6 se4
english_meaning: Grinning broadly while loosing a venomous snake — smiling but hiding a knife; treacherous.

jyutping: maa5 ziu3 paau2, mou5 ziu3 tiu3
mandarin_meaning: 係表示香港喺九七年之後，現狀唔變，保留資本主義制度，五十年不變
english_meaning: Horse races still run and dances still go on — life carries on unchanged (HK keeps capitalism for 50 years after 1997).

jyutping: zi1 siu2 siu2, baan6 doi6 biu2
english_meaning: Knows just a little but poses as the spokesman — claiming credit and showing off.

jyutping: mou5 gei2 noi6, baan6 daai6 doi2
mandarin_meaning: 大袋係粗俗語，意思係沙塵囂張嘅意思
english_meaning: Not long in the game yet acts the big shot — arrogant and full of swagger.

jyutping: ngaa4 zaam2 zaam2, sei2 dak1 caam2
english_meaning: Sharp-tongued and boastful, comes to a miserable end — trouble springs from the mouth.

jyutping: ngaan5 zaam2 zaam2, baan6 faa1 daan2
mandarin_meaning: 雖無過犯，面目可憎之輩
english_meaning: Eyes fluttering, playing the leading lady — a repulsive poseur though guilty of nothing.

jyutping: seng1 daai6 daai6, mou5 fo3 maai6
english_meaning: A loud voice but nothing to sell — all talk and exaggeration.

jyutping: ngaan5 daai6 daai6, ji6 hok6 waai6
mandarin_meaning: 青春少艾，容易誤入歧途
english_meaning: Wide-eyed and naive, easily led astray — the young readily fall into bad ways.

jyutping: zau1 san1 juk1, baan6 mong4 luk1
english_meaning: Fidgeting all over, pretending to be busy — all talk and little work.

jyutping: ngaan5 sap1 sap1, baan6 jau1 wat1
english_meaning: Teary-eyed, feigning sorrow — shedding crocodile tears.

jyutping: zeoi2 miu2 miu2, daa2 dak1 siu2
english_meaning: A sneering mouth that's been hit too seldom — a glib troublemaker stirring up strife.

jyutping: zing6 gai1 gai1, jing6 dai1 wai1
mandarin_meaning: 衰衰地慣鋪，向對方認錯
english_meaning: Quietly on the sly, owning up to a loss — meekly admitting fault to the other side.

jyutping: jau5 zou2 zi1, mou5 hat1 ji1
english_meaning: If only one knew in advance there'd be no beggars — hindsight is easy; the future is unpredictable.

jyutping: san4 zou2 zi1, zung3 saam1 ti1
mandarin_meaning: 三Ｔ係最多獎金嘅賽馬彩池，意思同上面嗰句相同
english_meaning: If you knew early you'd win the Triple Trio — foresight would make you rich (Triple Trio = the top horse-racing jackpot).

jyutping: daam1 dang3 zai2, baa3 tau4 wai2
english_meaning: Carrying a stool to grab the front seat — terrified of losing out.

jyutping: jat1 zoeng1 piu3, tai2 dou3 siu3
mandarin_meaning: 三級色情電影戲院買一張票可成日任睇
english_meaning: One ticket, watch till you laugh — at a Category III cinema one ticket lets you watch all day.

jyutping: hou2 hou2 hou2, tai2 m4 dou2
english_meaning: 'Fine, fine, fine' — yet never actually looks into it; perfunctory, just going through the motions.

jyutping: ngaau2 maai4 sau2, san4 zou2 zau2
english_meaning: Folding your arms and slipping off early — skiving and perfecting laziness.

jyutping: jau5 dak1 zan3, mou5 dak1 fan3
mandarin_meaning: 大禍臨頭；震，顫抖嘅意思
english_meaning: Trembling with no chance to sleep — disaster looms (震 = to shake with fear).

jyutping: gaau2 gaau2 zan3, mou5 bong1 can3
english_meaning: Stirring up trouble without ever buying anything — a disruptive troublemaker.

jyutping: zak1 zak1 bok3, m4 do1 gok3
english_meaning: Tilting a shoulder to dodge, barely noticed — shirking and doing things half-heartedly.

jyutping: bok3 daai6 mou6, m4 sai2 zou6
english_meaning: Fishing in muddy waters to avoid real work — exploiting confusion to slack off.

jyutping: jau5 zi1 sai3, mou5 sat6 zai3
english_meaning: All posture and no substance — outwardly impressive but hollow.

jyutping: jau5 gaau1 jik6, kaau3 sat6 lik6
english_meaning: Deals are won by real strength — not by crooked shortcuts.

jyutping: cat1 baat3 gau2, jam2 dou3 au2
mandarin_meaning: 七八九，係卡拉OK夜店嘅猜枚遊戲
english_meaning: 'Seven-eight-nine', drink till you puke — a karaoke-bar finger-guessing drinking game.

jyutping: ngaang6 gwat1 tau4, sik6 dei6 kau4
mandarin_meaning: 地球，指六、七十年代國產嘅地球牌香煙
english_meaning: A tough guy smoking 'Earth' cigarettes — (Earth = a 1960s–70s mainland cigarette brand).

jyutping: sau2 tau4 gan2, wan2 zan1 ngan2
english_meaning: Short on cash, go earn real money — work hard for your money.

jyutping: wu1 doeng1 doeng1, jam6 jan4 zoeng1
english_meaning: Muddle-headed, letting others checkmate you — so confused you're easily cheated.

jyutping: daam6 daam6 ding6, jau5 cin2 zing6
english_meaning: Stay calm and you'll have money to spare — keep cool under any circumstances.

jyutping: sat1 sat1 fong1, hoi6 gaai1 fong1
english_meaning: Panicking in a fluster harms the neighbours — a little impatience wrecks big plans.

jyutping: naa4 naa4 lam4, soeng5 king4 lam4
mandarin_meaning: 瓊林係一間著名嘅夜總會
english_meaning: Hurry up and head to Kinglam — (Kinglam, a famous old Hong Kong nightclub).

jyutping: hau2 hon5 hon5, sik6 kat1 tong2
english_meaning: Mouth bone-dry, sucking a cough drop — not a drop of saliva left.

jyutping: jau5 dak1 dou2, zing1 san4 hou2
english_meaning: Give him something to bet on and he's full of energy — a compulsive gambler.

jyutping: saam1 kyut3 jat1, caam2 gwo3 hat1
english_meaning: Three players, one short — worse than begging (a mahjong lament).

jyutping: si4 wan6 gou1, bok3 faan1 pou1
english_meaning: When luck is high, take a gamble — seize the moment.

jyutping: jin1 kei1 zik1, gam6 zyu6 ling1
english_meaning: A-K-J in hand, hold tight and press on — a poker (in-between) term for a very strong hand.

jyutping: ji6 zai2 dai2, mou5 dak1 tai2
english_meaning: A deuce as your hole card — a Show Hand poker term for weak odds: lose more than you win.

jyutping: ceoi4 hau2 ung1, dong3 bei3 kap1
english_meaning: Blurting out whatever and treating it as a secret manual — talking big to sound impressive.

jyutping: ziu1 mat1 zik1, zung3 wai4 tau4
english_meaning: ..., rolling boxed triples — haughty yet fortunate.

jyutping: jeng4 nap1 tong2, syu1 gaan1 cong2
english_meaning: Win a candy, lose a whole factory — gamble nine times and lose nine; gambling ruins you.

jyutping: jeng4 baa2 ze1, syu1 gaa3 ce1
english_meaning: Win an umbrella, lose a car — another version of the line above.

jyutping: min6 mung2 mung2, dong3 lou5 fung4
english_meaning: Blank-faced, taking it as his god-given right — acting entitled (老馮 = 'as of right').

jyutping: neoi5 jan4 sam1, hoi2 dai2 zam1
english_meaning: A woman's heart is a needle on the sea floor — fickle and impossible to fathom.

jyutping: sap6 baat3 lau2, zi6 gei2 jau2
english_meaning: Same eighteenth floor, we're our own folk — neighbours who look out for one another.

jyutping: jau5 dau3 hau2, zou2 di1 tau2
english_meaning: With a place of your own, turn in early — a wish that everyone had a roof overhead.

jyutping: duk6 syu1 siu2, bei2 jan4 miu2
mandarin_meaning: 學識低嘅人，會俾人睇唔起
english_meaning: Little schooling gets you looked down on — the poorly educated are scorned.

jyutping: tau4 ngok6 ngok6, sei3 wai4 dok6
english_meaning: Head bobbing about, pacing all around — bored and at a loose end.

jyutping: laan6 taat3 taat3, m4 fu6 zaak3
english_meaning: Sloppy and reckless, shirking all responsibility — a shameless lout.

jyutping: mou5 saai3 gai2, faat3 han2 lai6
mandarin_meaning: 唔按常理做事，趕狗入窮巷嘅意思
english_meaning: Out of options and flying into a vicious rage — acting against all reason, like a cornered dog.

jyutping: gaa3 lei1 fe1, baan6 aa3 ze2
english_meaning: A bit-part extra posing as the leading lady — a minnow passing itself off as a grouper.

jyutping: zi1 zi1 zing2, jau5 waan4 ging2
english_meaning: Fussing and primping, claiming to be well-off — giving the game away.

jyutping: gam3 jan4 cai4, dang2 faat3 wai4
english_meaning: Now everyone's here, let's make our mark — strength through unity.

jyutping: can3 keoi5 beng6, lo2 keoi5 meng6
english_meaning: Strike while he's ill and take his life — finishing off the enemy without mercy.

jyutping: ceot1 lei4 wai1, sik1 coeng2 mai1
english_meaning: If you come out to shine, know how to grab the mic — seize your chances.

jyutping: m4 soeng2 seoi1, maai4 daai6 deoi1
english_meaning: Don't want to fail? Join the crowd — there's strength in numbers.

jyutping: jau5 ji6 sing3, mou4 jan4 sing3
english_meaning: Once the opposite sex appears, all decency is gone — forgetting loyalty at the sight of a pretty face.

jyutping: jau5 saat3 co3, mou5 fong3 gwo3
english_meaning: Better to kill by mistake than let one slip — wrong the innocent rather than spare the guilty.

jyutping: jau5 hung1 mou4, ceot1 lei4 pou4
english_meaning: Chest hair out, prowling the night scene — the image of a tough guy.

jyutping: teng1 m4 ming4, baan6 seon4 cing4
english_meaning: Doesn't understand a word but feigns innocence — putting on an act.

jyutping: laan5 ci1 cin4, bok3 ho2 lin4
english_meaning: Clinging on lazily and fishing for pity — playing it up like a drama.

jyutping: daai6 daat3 dei6, sik6 zi6 gei2
mandarin_meaning: 大笪地，唧係香港嘅平民夜總會，係嗰度擺檔嘅都係自食其力嘅人
english_meaning: At the Big Bazaar, fend for yourself — (HK's old open-air people's market, where every stallholder made their own living).

jyutping: ngaan5 gwong1 gwong1, dang2 tin1 gwong1
english_meaning: Eyes wide open, waiting for dawn — sleepless and heavy with worries.

jyutping: jan3 jan3 goek3, dang2 jan4 joek3
english_meaning: Jiggling your leg, waiting for someone to call — idle with nothing to do.

jyutping: jau5 dyun3 gu2, mou5 tung3 fu2
english_meaning: Just guess away and you'll feel no pain — bliss lies in not knowing too much.

jyutping: nin2 zoek3 lung4, ci4 zou2 kung4
english_meaning: Fussing over a birdcage, you'll soon be broke — the image of a wastrel.

jyutping: jan4 gung1 gou1, mou5 bei3 lou1
english_meaning: High salary, no secret side gig — (secret side gig = moonlighting on the quiet).

jyutping: m4 gau3 baan1, zap1 ji6 taan1
english_meaning: Not up to the grade, picking up the leftovers — not making the cut.

jyutping: gan1 lou5 ding2, jau5 dak1 sing2
mandarin_meaning: 老頂，大哥大之輩；醒，有好處同著數
english_meaning: Stick with the big boss and you'll get perks — ('醒' = benefits and kickbacks).

jyutping: zoek3 cou2 haai4, jau5 paai4 ngaai4
mandarin_meaning: 著草，係黑語，即係走路嘅意思
english_meaning: Once you're on the run, a long hard slog awaits — (to wear straw sandals = underworld slang for fleeing).

jyutping: zau2 dak1 faai3, hou2 sai3 gaai3
english_meaning: Whoever runs fast has the good life — a childhood rhyme.

jyutping: zau2 dak1 mo1, mou5 bei6 go1
mandarin_meaning: 鼻哥即鼻樑；意謂走得慢，冇好下場
english_meaning: Run too slow and you lose your nose — i.e. dawdlers come to a bad end (鼻哥 = nose).

jyutping: nei5 lou5 dau6, daai6 seoi2 ngau4
english_meaning: Your old man's a big water buffalo — a childhood taunt.

jyutping: nei5 lou5 mou2, daai6 fung1 lou4
mandarin_meaning: 都係童年時嘅罵人順口溜
english_meaning: Your old mum's a big stove — another childhood taunt.

jyutping: daai6 tou5 dam3, mou5 loeng4 sam1
english_meaning: Big-bellied and heartless — a childhood rhyme.

jyutping: daai6 haa1 sai3, bei2 si2 wai3
english_meaning: The big bully the small, fed with crap — (欺 is read 'haa1', to bully).

jyutping: jau5 bik1 gwaan3, mou5 kwan3 naan4
english_meaning: With the right 'background', nothing is hard — (迫慣 = phonetic for 'background', i.e. connections).

jyutping: jau5 go1 lei6, daai6 caan1 si2
mandarin_meaning: 哥利Quality，係指資歷聲望，餐史Chance，係機會嘅意思
english_meaning: With 'quality' comes 'chance' — (哥利 = quality/reputation; 餐史 = chance/opportunity).

jyutping: mat6 hoeng2 go1, mou5 lat1 to1
english_meaning: Keep ringing the 'call' and you won't slip up — diligence makes up for shortcomings (歌 = 'call').

jyutping: sau2 zi2 zi2, baan6 faan1 si2
mandarin_meaning: 扮熟絡狀，FAN屎，超級歌迷影迷
english_meaning: Pointing fingers, acting the 'fan' — feigning familiarity (fan屎 = a super fan).

jyutping: hei2 daai6 uk1, kaau3 biu2 suk1
mandarin_meaning: 想係大陸發達，就要依靠大陸啲高幹
english_meaning: To build a big house, lean on your mainland uncle — getting rich on the mainland means relying on high cadres.

jyutping: sap6 sap6 haa5, laai1 tau4 maa5
mandarin_meaning: 十＝霎，香港人極為抵死嘅用語，一個人霎吓霎吓，表示一個人渾渾噩噩；意思係傻人有傻福，胡里胡塗，無端端發達
english_meaning: Bumbling along in a daze, yet you snag the winning horse — fortune favours the simple-minded (十 = 霎, dazed).

jyutping: zung1 gaan1 gaai3, ke4 lei1 gwaai3
mandarin_meaning: 中間分界嘅髮型，騎喱怪，正字係騎籬蟈，意思為形象標奇立異古怪出位之人；騎籬係伏喺籬笆上嘅意思；蟈係一種墨綠色嘅蛙類動物
english_meaning: A centre-parted hairstyle, an oddball freak — someone deliberately bizarre and attention-seeking.

jyutping: m4 gau3 pei2, mou4 min2 bei2
mandarin_meaning: 皮＝皮費，經營開支洗費；唔夠錢用時，咩人都唔賣帳
english_meaning: Can't cover the costs, so no one gives you face — short of money, you get no respect (皮 = costs/overheads).

jyutping: ji6 saam1 sin3, hou2 naan4 bin3
mandarin_meaning: 二三線指唔係主角嘅次級貨色，係唔好嘅嘢好難會變好嘅
english_meaning: Second- and third-tier stuff is hard to turn around — inferior goods rarely improve.

jyutping: hai6 gam3 ji6, daai3 lou1 si2
mandarin_meaning: 表示囂張，撈屎，勞力士金錶
english_meaning: Easy as that, sporting a Rolex — flaunting wealth (撈屎 = a Rolex gold watch).

jyutping: mou5 laa1 laa1, zing2 daat3 baa1
mandarin_meaning: 疤讀啦音，意謂畫蛇添足
english_meaning: For no reason, making a scar — pointless meddling, gilding the lily (疤 read 'laa1').

jyutping: baak6 baak6 zeng6, mou5 sing3 beng6
mandarin_meaning: 稱讚女仔嘅說話，不過係諗緊啲邪嘢
english_meaning: Fair and clean-skinned, free of disease — flattering words to a girl, with dirty thoughts behind them.

jyutping: jan4 haak3 jan4, hou2 ji6 wan4
mandarin_meaning: 廣東俗語有人嚇人無藥醫，意思謂俾人嚇慘過俾鬼嚇
english_meaning: People scaring people is easily fatal — a Cantonese saying: a human fright is worse than a ghostly one.

jyutping: wan2 wan2 zan6, zou6 bun3 fan6
mandarin_meaning: 安全第一，辦事唔好博得太盡
english_meaning: Play it safe, take only half a share — safety first; never push your luck too far.

jyutping: sau2 tau4 gan2, maai6 baak6 fan2
mandarin_meaning: 狗急跳牆，不擇手段，唔理後果
english_meaning: Strapped for cash, peddling heroin — a cornered dog will stop at nothing, heedless of the cost.

jyutping: ceoi1 ceoi1 seoi2, m4 maat3 zeoi2
mandarin_meaning: 吹水，口沫橫飛，愛吹牛皮
english_meaning: Chatting up a storm without wiping your mouth — shooting the breeze and loving to brag.

jyutping: can3 nei5 beng6, taat3 nei5 deng6
mandarin_meaning: 撻定係地產買賣術語，放棄交易之意，全句係解乘人之危同落井下石
english_meaning: While you're ill, forfeit your deposit — kicking you when you're down (撻訂 = forfeiting a property deposit).

jyutping: m4 jung6 nou5, dang2 wan6 dou3
mandarin_meaning: 批評嚚啲靠好彩唔係靠勤力嘅人
english_meaning: Don't use your head, just wait for luck — a jab at those who rely on luck rather than effort.

jyutping: din1 din1 dei2, m4 sik1 sei2
english_meaning: A bit crazy and reckless — no sense of danger, not knowing how high heaven is.

jyutping: zaan6 faai3 cin2, caau2 maa1 zin2
mandarin_meaning: 孖展，高風險嘅投資方法，如同賭博，可以發大達，又可傾家蕩產
english_meaning: To make a fast buck, trade on margin — (margin trading: high risk like gambling, can make or break you).

jyutping: gwo3 daai6 hoi2, bok3 hou2 coi2
mandarin_meaning: 大海指澳門，香港人喺假期過澳門搏殺
english_meaning: Cross the sea to chance your luck — ('the sea' = Macau; Hongkongers gamble there on holidays).

jyutping: hau2 seoi2 do1, mou4 niu6 o1
mandarin_meaning: 指喜歡發表偉論嘅人，口水多過茶，口水多到連尿都唔使去屙，其吹水程度之厲害可想而知
english_meaning: So much spit there's no pee left — said of someone who loves to pontificate; their gushing is legendary.

jyutping: dong3 ngo5 lau4, paau1 long6 tau4
mandarin_meaning: 流即假嘢，唔係真材實料，拋浪頭即係靠吹牛皮，靠嚇
english_meaning: Taking me for a fool while putting on a bluff — (流 = fake; 拋浪頭 = blustering and bluffing).

jyutping: ceot1 lei4 wan6, mou4 zaak3 jam6
mandarin_meaning: 指吊兒郎噹，不負責任嘅人
english_meaning: Out making your way yet shirking all duty — a careless, irresponsible sort.

jyutping: jat6 bun2 syun4, ci4 zou2 jyun4
mandarin_meaning: 有一隻日本郵船，個名叫做遲早「丸」，係完嘅諧音，意思係件事情好快就會失敗
english_meaning: A Japanese ship named 'Sooner or Later' — ('丸/maru' on Japanese ships puns on 完, 'finished'; the matter will soon fail).

jyutping: maa5 ziu3 paau2, neoi5 ziu3 gaau2
mandarin_meaning: 九七年之後，香港保留資本主義制度，五十年不變。
english_meaning: Horse races still run and womanising goes on — HK keeps capitalism unchanged for 50 years after 1997.

jyutping: mou5 ziu3 tiu3, gai1 ziu3 giu3
mandarin_meaning: 跳舞、召妓等夜生活照舊，借指九七後香港生活方式不變。
english_meaning: Dances still go on and prostitutes still ply their trade — life carries on unchanged.

jyutping: baau1 ji6 naai1, sat6 teng1 laai1
mandarin_meaning: 香港人回大陸偷情十分危險。
english_meaning: Keep a mistress and you'll surely be nabbed — having an affair back on the mainland is very risky.

jyutping: ziu1 do1 gin6, lo1 lai4 zin6
english_meaning: Stirring up more trouble and bringing cheapness on yourself — you ask for your own disgrace.

jyutping: sing3 sing3 zan3, sik6 gaap3 gan1
english_meaning: Shaking with cockiness, then biting your own tongue — a slip amid the rush; haste makes mistakes.

jyutping: sai3 sai3 dau1, jung4 ji6 kau1
mandarin_meaning: 初出茅廬少女，容易被騙，追求異性也。
english_meaning: A young, green girl is easily wooed — naive young girls are readily fooled and courted.

jyutping: mou4 dyun1 dyun1, siu1 ceoi1 kyun4
english_meaning: Out of nowhere, utterly inexplicable — baffling and without rhyme or reason.

jyutping: min6 zong6 min6, hou2 min6 sin6
english_meaning: Face to face, looking so familiar — as if we've met somewhere before.

jyutping: mou5 saai3 gai2, faat3 long2 lai5
mandarin_meaning: 意思不按常理做事，全句是趕狗入窮巷也。
english_meaning: Out of all options, flying into a rage — acting irrationally, like driving a dog into a dead end.

jyutping: pan4 pan4 pok3, mou5 lyun4 lok3
english_meaning: Rushing about everywhere yet out of touch — important folk are forgetful.

jyutping: sau2 mou4 coeng4, sing3 juk6 koeng4
mandarin_meaning: 順口溜而已，無科學根據。
english_meaning: Long arm hair means a strong sex drive — just a rhyme, with no scientific basis.

jyutping: zou6 cau3 sei3, mou5 deng6 kei5
mandarin_meaning: 臭四，對不住朋友之徒，必無好下場。
english_meaning: Be a backstabber and you'll have nowhere to stand — one who lets friends down comes to no good.

jyutping: dyun3 mat1 gu2, mou5 tung3 fu2
english_meaning: What's there to guess? — no pain in not knowing; bliss in ignorance.

jyutping: lam1 baa1 wan1, jau5 man4 san1
english_meaning: 'Number One', with a tattoo — the big boss of the gang.

jyutping: zaa1 fit1 jan4, jau5 baa1 han4
english_meaning: The 'cha-fit' boss, marked with scars — (underworld slang for a top leader).

jyutping: hok6 caai1 mui2, kau1 biu2 mui2
mandarin_meaning: 猜牧，是燈紅酒綠場所的玩意，表妹指大陸女孩。
english_meaning: Learn finger-guessing to chat up the 'cousin' — (a wine-house game; '表妹' = a mainland girl).

jyutping: maai5 laam4 cau2, m4 sai2 sau4
english_meaning: Buy blue chips and you needn't worry — (blue chips = top-quality stocks).

jyutping: sei3 wai4 zau2, dau3 dip6 jau2
mandarin_meaning: 疊友，墨幫背語。指人強馬壯。
english_meaning: Drinking all around, competing in numbers — (疊友, gang slang: a show of strength in numbers).

jyutping: fu3 tau4 sung1, bok3 gaai1 zung1
mandarin_meaning: 街鐘，歡場術語，客人帶小姐外出為街鐘，小姐要有街鐘，多賺錢，那麼就不能惜身如玉。
english_meaning: Loose morals, hustling for 'street bells' — (nightlife slang for a callgirl taking outcall jobs to earn more).

jyutping: paau2 zung1 zai2, tip3 go1 zai2
mandarin_meaning: 鐘仔，亦是歡場術語，指應召女郎有客召喚，此句是指許多歡場女子，辛辛苦苦為了哥仔男友。
english_meaning: Running the 'bells' to bankroll her boyfriend — many nightclub girls toil hard for their men.

jyutping: maai6 daai6 baau1, jam6 jan4 caau1
english_meaning: Selling big buns, letting all help themselves — being generous and not fussing over gains and losses.

jyutping: tang4 tang4 zan3, haa1 gwong1 gwan3
mandarin_meaning: 趾高氣揚、欺負勢孤力弱的人。
english_meaning: Swaggering about and bullying single men — a cocky bully who picks on the weak.

jyutping: pan4 pan4 pok3, wan2 meng6 bok3
mandarin_meaning: 四處奔波，拼命勞碌、搏盡全力。
english_meaning: Rushing about everywhere, risking life and limb — slaving away desperately to scrape a living.

jyutping: ceoi1 haa5 seoi2, jam6 nei5 zeoi2
mandarin_meaning: 隨便閒聊吹噓，任你信口開河。
english_meaning: Shoot the breeze and let your mouth run — talk all you like; idle boasting.

jyutping: joeng2 gwaai3 gwaai3, sei2 dik1 faai3
mandarin_meaning: 樣子古怪的人，往往倒霉得快。
english_meaning: Looking weird gets you done in fast — an odd appearance brings a quick downfall.

jyutping: tin1 gwong1 gwong1, bei2 jan4 zong1
mandarin_meaning: 光天化日之下被人窺看、暗中監視。
english_meaning: In broad daylight, you get spied on — exposed and watched by others (裝 = to spy on).

jyutping: m4 sik1 zi6, baan6 bok3 si6
mandarin_meaning: 不識字卻假裝博學，冒充內行。
english_meaning: Illiterate yet posing as a scholar — faking expertise.

jyutping: mit1 mit1 goek3, jau5 jan4 joek3
mandarin_meaning: 抖抖腳就有人來相約，純屬順口溜。
english_meaning: Fidget your leg and an invitation comes — just a playful rhyme.

jyutping: siu2 siu2 nap1, bei2 jan4 haa1
mandarin_meaning: 個子小小，容易被人欺負。
english_meaning: Small in size, you get bullied — the little ones get pushed around.

jyutping: ak1 ak1 sau2, hou2 pang4 jau5
mandarin_meaning: 握握手就是好朋友，小孩間的順口溜。
english_meaning: Shake hands and we're good friends — a friendly children's rhyme.

jyutping: sau2 zi2 zi2, sik6 gai1 ci2
mandarin_meaning: 亂指指點點，小孩戲謔的順口溜。
english_meaning: Point your fingers and you'll eat 'chicken persimmons' — a teasing childhood rhyme.

jyutping: dak1 baa1 hau2, m4 zi1 cau2
english_meaning: Running your mouth shamelessly — chattering nonsense without any embarrassment.

jyutping: je6 maa4 maa4, ci1 gaau1 faa1
mandarin_meaning: 深夜還在黏膠花，形容捱夜辛勤幹活（昔日香港家庭手工業）。
english_meaning: Deep in the night, still sticking plastic flowers — toiling late at an old HK cottage-industry job.

jyutping: jau5 jyu4 gwo2, mou5 din1 po4
mandarin_meaning: 世事沒有如果，凡事難以重來。
english_meaning: If only 'ifs' existed, there'd be no madwomen — there are no what-ifs in life.

jyutping: sei2 muk6 zeoi2, lau4 hau2 seoi2
mandarin_meaning: 呆頭呆腦、口水直流，形容人愚鈍木訥。
english_meaning: A dumb wooden mouth, drooling away — a slow-witted, gormless look.

jyutping: sai3 haa1 daai6, zaa1 heoi3 maai6
mandarin_meaning: 以小欺大，反被抓去賣，比喻不自量力自招禍患。
english_meaning: When the small bully the big, they get carted off and sold — overreaching invites disaster.

jyutping: laan5 aa1 cin4, baan6 ho2 lin4
mandarin_meaning: 死纏爛打、扮可憐博取同情。
english_meaning: Clinging on lazily and putting on a pitiful act — milking sympathy.

jyutping: siu2 neoi5 zi2, mou5 hau2 ci2
mandarin_meaning: 小女子不守信用、講話不算數。
english_meaning: A little miss who won't keep her word — unreliable and untrustworthy.

jyutping: joeng2 seoi1 seoi1, bei6 gau2 zeoi1
mandarin_meaning: 樣子難看，連狗都追著咬，戲謔之語。
english_meaning: An ugly mug gets chased by dogs — a teasing rhyme about a sorry-looking face.

jyutping: m4 zi1 cau2, saang1 dau6 dau2
mandarin_meaning: 不知羞恥就會長痘痘，小孩戲謔的順口溜。
english_meaning: Shameless folk break out in pimples — a children's teasing rhyme.

jyutping: ngam6 geoi1 geoi1, sik6 zin1 deoi1
mandarin_meaning: 傻頭傻腦、憨憨地，形容人愚笨。
english_meaning: A dim-witted fool munching fried dumplings — the look of a simpleton.
